## Checklist (see docs/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Tests added or updated (code written by an AI agent must come with tests)
- [ ] Documentation updated in both languages (`<name>.md` and `<name>.zh-CN.md`) where affected
- [ ] No machine-local information (absolute paths, machine names, personal tooling) in the diff
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and are written in English
